short_description: Circle-time talk game: every question, comment and idea adds a block to the class tower. Cards, script, trackers, slides and a bonus story. Ages 3–7.
long_description:
Talk Tower turns circle time into a game every child can join. Each time a child asks a question, says something back, adds one more idea or shows they listened, a colorful block goes on the class tower. Everyone builds one tower together, so there are no winners, no points and no blocks taken away.

Inside you'll find 32 tower-block turn cards in four colors, 36 prompt and topic cards, name blocks with a whose-turn mat, a weekly turn tracker, and a Talking Star with a 'Tower wobble!' sign for quick resets. A one-page, word-for-word teacher script gets your first round going in about ten minutes, and six circle-time variations keep it fresh all year, each with an easier and a stretch option.

Every way of talking counts: spoken words, signing, pointing, picture cards and communication devices all earn a block, and 'pass' is always OK.

Two family take-home pages bring the game to the dinner table, a class certificate celebrates your tallest tower, and a 20-slide deck lets you project the blocks and topics for the whole group. As a bonus you also get More Talk, Less Tap, a 32-page read-aloud story about a class that builds its own Talk Tower.

US Letter and A4 PDFs for ages 3–7, preschool to grade 2. Choose a single-classroom license or a site license for your whole school or center.

compliance_notes: Rule 1: no health, medical or clinical claims; no 'therapy', 'speech therapy', 'SLP', 'clinically proven', diagnosis or disorder words anywhere; the kit says it is general classroom play ideas and not a program, assessment, screening tool or professional advice; the tracker says it is a play game, not a measurement or screening tool. No SLP or clinical authorship implied. Autism rule: no autism or diagnosis keywords, tags or copy in the kit, slides or listing. Rule 2: no school, district, company, app, device or EdTech product named or shown; no local angle; the story's Room 5, Ms. Poppy and children are fictional. Rule 5: no research citations used. Rule 6: talk tips use plain words only (pause and wait, say what you see, repeat and add one word, follow their lead); no trademarked program names. Rule 4 child safety: adult supervision stated on the safety page and family page; paper pieces are large; real blocks or objects near under-3s must be too big to fit through a toilet-paper tube (about 1.25 in / 3.2 cm); Mystery Bag objects follow the same rule; soft large ball rolled on the floor; no balloons under 8; pushpins, staples and small magnets kept out of reach. Inclusion: every mode of communication earns a block, pass is always OK, class totals only, blocks never taken away, no individual ranking. Rule 7 and logo rules: original names, characters and page designs; final logo kit from brand/logo/ (horizontal lockup, one-colour white on the story's tomato and sky covers); blocks appear only as game art and illustration, never as a logo, product mark or series mark, and the Talk Tower title is set in type. Privacy: the bonus asks for an email only (no child names); the kit asks families and teachers not to post children's names or faces. Legal: copyright line '© 2026 AlphaPlay LLC. Play Before Pixels is a trade name of AlphaPlay LLC.' on the license page, the story copyright page and in every page footer with the short license notice (per legal/protection/digital-product-license.md, Part A). The license page is drafted from the DRAFT license template and needs attorney review. PDF metadata carries the copyright and license URL. Printing: printables are Letter and A4 with 0.5 in margins and no bleed; test-print at 100% before sale. The bonus story is RGB with 0.125 in bleed; if a print edition ever returns, check it against the chosen printer's current template (KDP, IngramSpark, Lulu, etc.) before upload.
